text:
Asha: dropping a compact-tile prototype for charting. main questions: legend density (chips vs dropdown), x-axis label handling on narrow widths, unit badge behavior, smoothing exposure, and how to represent extreme outliers. link: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-tiles-proto

Marco: chips look tidy but can overflow. idea: show 3 chips then a "+n" pill that opens a panel with checkboxes. keeps context.

Eve: +1. make the +n pill keyboard-focusable and announced (e.g., "More series, 5 hidden"). also ensure chips have 44px min tap area.

Ravi: for x-axis, rotate 45deg for timestamps, ellipsize long categories. when rotated, expand hit area for hover.

A11yBot: accessibility notes:
- +n panel: role=dialog, manage focus on open, restore on close.
- Chips: ensure contrast >=4.5:1 and provide aria-pressed on toggleable chips.
- Unit badge: role=button with aria-haspopup=menu and clear label ("Units: auto").

Asha: units: propose per-tile badge (Auto/Raw/SI/Human) defaulted by metadata + quick toggle in header. show unit in tooltip too.

Marco: smoothing: default light smoothing (moving avg) but allow per-series toggle. also overlay raw points on hover so spikes aren't hidden.

Eve: add a small tilde icon in legend items for smoothed series; click toggles. hover tooltip should show both smoothed and raw values when available.

Ravi: outliers: current clamp at 99.9th percentile with a caret showing count. prefer whisker to percentile + overflow caret that expands to full-scale on click and opens a list of top outliers. export must include raw values.

A11yBot: overflow caret must be role=button and have aria-describedby linking to the outlier list. the list modal needs proper headings and keyboard nav.

Asha: config I'm testing:

legendStyle: chip-collapsible
legendPreviewCount: 3
unitOptions: [auto, raw, si, human]
smoothing: { method: moving_average, default: smoothed, perSeriesToggle: true }
outlier: { strategy: whisker_overflow, percentile: 99.9 }

Eve: small copy nit: call it `legendPreviewCount` not `legendPreviewLimit`.

Marco: approve :+1: will add animation on expand so users don't lose context.

Ravi: approve, will file a11y PR for focus flow and ARIA attributes.

Asha: thanks all. I'll update figma and post follow-up with screens. Adding note to release draft about CSV raw-value exports. Closing thread after fig updates.
